programs.title: Deadly Infidelity
programs.desc: Awakening from a month-long coma, a woman discovers the last five years of memories of her husband and daughter are gone. However, things go from bad to dangerous when a man she doesn't remember appears, claiming they had a passionate affair.

programs.title: Cheating for Your Life
programs.desc: When star student Kaley gets suspicious of a group of underachievers' high SAT scores, she unwittingly uncovers a cheating ring and puts her life in jeopardy.

programs.title: A Dangerous Affair
programs.desc: Pilates instructor Amélie Didot begins a steamy love affair with one of her handsome clients, journalist Pierce Dalton. However, when a killer develops an erotic obsession with Pierce, Amélie finds herself in the middle of a deadly love triangle.

programs.title: Envy: A Seven Deadly Sins Story
programs.desc: Gabrielle seems to have it all -- a devoted husband, a beautiful daughter and a successful career in public relations. However, she soon stands to lose everything when she meets Keisha, her devious half sister who wants everything Gabrielle has.

programs.title: My Husband's Worst Mistake
programs.desc: Brad Collins' love for his wife, Amy, becomes an all-encompassing obsession, and he grows more and more controlling of her with each passing year. When Brad finds out that Amy had an affair with a colleague, a huge fight ensues and tragedy results.

programs.title: Secret Life of the Surgeon's Wife
programs.desc: A woman tries to prove her husband is having an affair so she can initiate a divorce. She soon finds herself romantically involved with the other woman's husband, unaware that her own husband and his mistress are plotting to kill them.
